title: Backend
description: FastAPI, Flask, routers, middleware, dependency injection, request lifecycle, lifespan, background tasks, validation, response models, async, concurrency, and parallelism.

lessons.title: Backend Frameworks
lessons.summary: FastAPI emphasizes type hints, Pydantic validation, OpenAPI, and async support; Flask is lighter.
lessons.explanation: FastAPI emphasizes type hints, Pydantic validation, OpenAPI, and async support; Flask is lighter. In interviews, explain the concept, when it applies, and the trade-off it introduces. Use concrete examples from the provided material instead of definitions alone.
examples: A typed FastAPI endpoint documents and validates request bodies automatically.
interview_questions: When would you apply backend frameworks?
What failure mode appears when backend frameworks is misunderstood?

lessons.title: Routers, Middleware, and DI
lessons.summary: Routers organize endpoints; middleware wraps requests; dependency injection supplies shared objects.
lessons.explanation: Routers organize endpoints; middleware wraps requests; dependency injection supplies shared objects. In interviews, explain the concept, when it applies, and the trade-off it introduces. Use concrete examples from the provided material instead of definitions alone.
examples: A database session dependency can be replaced in tests.

lessons.title: Lifespan, Validation, and Responses
lessons.summary: Startup initializes shared resources; validation rejects bad input; response models prevent leaking fields.
lessons.explanation: Startup initializes shared resources; validation rejects bad input; response models prevent leaking fields. In interviews, explain the concept, when it applies, and the trade-off it introduces. Use concrete examples from the provided material instead of definitions alone.
examples: A password hash should not appear in a response model.

lessons.title: Async, Concurrency, and Parallelism
lessons.summary: Async helps while waiting on I/O; parallelism helps CPU-heavy work.
lessons.explanation: Async helps while waiting on I/O; parallelism helps CPU-heavy work. In interviews, explain the concept, when it applies, and the trade-off it introduces. Use concrete examples from the provided material instead of definitions alone.
examples: Awaiting a database call lets other requests progress on the event loop.

coding_challenges.title: Backend status classifier
coding_challenges.instructions: Implement classify_status_code(code: int) -> str. Return success for 200-299, redirect for 300-399, client_error for 400-499, server_error for 500-599, and unknown otherwise.
coding_challenges.explanation: The challenge reinforces deterministic branching, status-code categories, and local test execution.
